newsitem.title: UK: Euro palm oils lower at close.
newsitem.headline: Euro palm oils lower at close.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed lower but steadier despite an afternoon of no trade.
The palm oils remained under renewed pressure from fresh losses seen in early Chicago soybean oil futures trading, ending mostly $2.50 to $5 lower.

No trade was reported during the afternoon, although in the morning session RBD palm oil traded Aug at $547.50, stearin traded 1-7 July at $395 and Aug at $387.50, while olein sold Aug at $547.50, $547 and lastly at $545.
The lauric oils closed tradeless but $2.50 lower to $5 up.
The soft oils largely ignored recent developments in Chicago but drifted slightly lower by the close to reside unchanged to 0.50 guilders below Thursday's finish.
The business reported on the soft oils, was for Aug/Oct soy oil at 104.25 guilders per 100 kilos.
